summary: FEAT-463 (matrix-agents-swarm) provides all infrastructure: full docker-compose dev stack, bootstrap script, example YAML configs, and runner scripts. However, the example cannot run end-to-end because swarm_example.py has stub agent registration (_setup_bots logs a warning instead of creating real agents). FEAT-464 fills this gap: a complete, self-contained sample with real Agent instances, system prompts, tools, and an agents.yaml definition file — so that a user can go from `git clone` to agents talking on Matrix in under 5 minutes.

hypotheses.statement: The sample needs: (1) an agents.yaml defining the 4 swarm agents with real LLM backends and system prompts, (2) a complete swarm_example.py that instantiates real agents from BotManager, (3) a step-by-step README.md quickstart, and (4) optionally a Makefile or script for one-command demo launch.
hypotheses.reasoning: All infrastructure exists. The only gap is agent definitions and the glue to go from config to running agents.

in_scope: examples/matrix_swarm/agents.yaml — 4 agent definitions with system prompts, tools, LLM config
examples/matrix_swarm/swarm_demo.py — runnable demo with real Agent instances from BotManager
examples/matrix_swarm/README.md — step-by-step quickstart from zero to running swarm
examples/matrix_swarm/Makefile — convenience targets: setup, start, stop, logs, demo
examples/matrix_swarm/.env.example — all required environment variables with descriptions

constraints.description: FEAT-464 depends on FEAT-463 core modules being implemented (at minimum TASK-2478 config models + TASK-2484 transport wiring + TASK-2483 toolkit). The sample imports these.
Must follow existing example patterns: argparse CLI, async with transport, signal handlers. See swarm_example.py and collaborative_example.py for the established pattern.
Agent definitions must use chatbot_ids matching swarm_crew.yaml: web-researcher, financial-analyst, report-writer, synthesis-agent
Synapse/Element/mautrix are AGPL-3.0, run as containers only. Never imported by MIT-licensed ai-parrot Python code.
